title: Why Does Helium Really Change Your Voice?
topic: Why helium makes your voice sound higher
description: In this video, you will learn how sound waves travel faster through helium gas because of its low density. You will discover how this shifts vocal tract resonances to change your voice timbre instead of raising your vocal cord pitch. Subscribe and follow us for more.
